name: S10_mit_supercloud_2021-08-11
description: Real GPU job timeline from the MIT SuperCloud TX-GAIA cluster for 2021-08-11 (UTC), replayed at its true start and end times. 154 GPU jobs; peak 424 concurrent V100s scaled to 50.0 MW of H100-chassis-equivalent compute (scale factor is a modelling choice, PROPOSED_HERE). This day follows a maintenance drain: repeated whole-cluster gang jobs step the site between near-zero and full GPU load within seconds, then production work refills in the evening. Shape is real; V100 power physics are not modelled. Source data CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 — internal use.
